name: Prepaid Cards and Stored Value Abuse
description: Prepaid cards and digital stored-value products can be loaded, transferred and cashed out quickly, sometimes with limited customer identification. Criminals use them to move small amounts at scale, convert cash, receive fraud proceeds and fund illicit purchases, often via many cards or mule holders.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach to Prepaid Cards, Mobile Payments and Internet-Based Payment Services (2013)
FATF, Opportunities and Challenges of New Technologies for AML/CFT (2021)

exposure.rationale: Bulk loads and cash-out of prepaid cards by many holders or mules.

indicators.name: Bulk purchase of cards by one person or entity
indicators.canon: Bulk purchase or sale of cards or vouchers
indicators.desc: Large volumes of prepaid cards or gift cards are purchased or sold.
indicators.ctx: One buyer acquires many cards, often in cash, with a common funding source or shipping address.

indicators.name: Cards funded by many unrelated third parties
indicators.canon: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
indicators.desc: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
indicators.ctx: Multiple unconnected payers load one card or small set of cards.

indicators.name: Loads immediately followed by foreign ATM withdrawals
indicators.canon: Loads immediately followed by foreign ATM withdrawals
indicators.desc: Funds are drawn down in cash overseas or in high-risk locations soon after loading.
indicators.ctx: Funds are drawn down in cash overseas or in high-risk locations soon after loading.

indicators.name: Repeated loads just below identification thresholds
indicators.canon: Non-cash transfers or loads just below identification or reporting thresholds
indicators.desc: Repeated transfers, remittances or card/wallet loads kept just below an identification, record-keeping or travel-rule threshold.
indicators.ctx: Multiple loads sized to avoid enhanced verification.

indicators.name: Multiple cards sharing identifiers
indicators.canon: Multiple customers sharing contact details or addresses
indicators.desc: Unrelated customers or applicants share the same phone, email, address, device or bank account, including mail drops and shared accommodation.
indicators.ctx: Different cardholders share phone, address, email or device.

indicators.name: Anonymous or minimally verified cards with high turnover
indicators.canon: Anonymous or lightly verified prepaid or stored-value instruments
indicators.desc: Prepaid cards or stored-value products without full ID, with high load limits, cross-border use or turnover inconsistent with design.
indicators.ctx: Cards without full ID show large inflows and outflows inconsistent with low-limit design.

indicators.name: Card used to pay high-risk online merchants
indicators.canon: Card used to pay high-risk online merchants
indicators.desc: Spend concentrates at gambling, darknet-adjacent or unlicensed merchants.
indicators.ctx: Spend concentrates at gambling, darknet-adjacent or unlicensed merchants.

indicators.name: Rapid transfers of stored value between wallets then cash-out
indicators.canon: Rapid stored-value or wallet hops then cash-out
indicators.desc: Stored value or funds move quickly between wallets or cards and are then cashed out.
indicators.ctx: Funds hop across stored-value accounts to peer wallets, then to cash or crypto.

indicators.name: Cards received by mules and redirected abroad
indicators.canon: Delivery to forwarder, mailbox or address unrelated to buyer
indicators.desc: Goods or cards are shipped to freight forwarders, reshippers, mail drops or addresses with no storage or sales operations or link to the buyer.
indicators.ctx: Cards shipped to freight forwarders or mail drops, then used elsewhere.

indicators.name: Tops-up with fraudulent funding sources
indicators.desc: Loads via cards or accounts reported stolen, followed by cash-out.
indicators.ctx: Loads via cards or accounts reported stolen, followed by cash-out.
